notes.title: April Demo UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all. Big update for the demo has just been released. 

Notable changes:

- Miss percentage in battle near the start has been majorly reduced. 
- Lots of changes to dialogue/scenes and a "Hints" section of the main menu to make it much clearer where to go at every point. 
- Several new music tracks (including Battle, Overworld, Town and Dungeon themes).
- Custom-made battlebacks have been added for all battle locations.
- Overworld revamped (made bigger and more expansive in the classic JRPG style, easier to find towns and castles too).
- Skills overhaul (skills are given earlier, have better vfx and are more useful in general).
- Balance overhaul (lots of tiny changes to provide a smoother snese of progression).
- Cut scenes editing (all are much shorter with less wasted time and fewer but more meaningful animations).
- Lots of tiny changes, bug fixes and other things that might get boring to read if I listed every single one. 

I think the game has changed a lot and hopefully been improved a lot too!
